an8.58:1.1: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an8.58:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an8.58:1.5: āraddhaviriyo hoti thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an8.58:1.7: aratiratisaho hoti uppannaṃ aratiṃ abhibhuyya viharati
an8.58:1.8: bhayabheravasaho hoti uppannaṃ bhayabheravaṃ abhibhuyya viharati
an8.58:1.9: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an8.58:1.11: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti. 59
